HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
2011 Equity Incentive Plan of Harbor Labs, Inc., adopted by the board on June 15,
2011
Shares reserved under the plan: 250,000 shares of common stock.
Awards: incentive stock options, nonstatutory stock options and restricted stock.
Exercise price: at least fair market value on the grant date.
Standard vesting: 25 percent after one year, then monthly over the next 36 months.
The board administers the plan. The plan ends after 10 years.
